name: EU Artificial Intelligence Act

use_case_categories: all AI systems placed on EU market or affecting EU persons
scope.description: Applies to providers and deployers of AI systems in the EU market, including systems developed outside the EU whose output is used in the EU.

requirements.obligation: Risk classification of AI systems into four tiers: unacceptable (prohibited), high-risk, limited-risk, and minimal-risk
requirements.penalty: Up to 35M EUR or 7% global annual turnover

requirements.obligation: High-risk AI systems must establish a risk management system throughout the system lifecycle
requirements.penalty: Up to 15M EUR or 3% global annual turnover

requirements.obligation: Training, validation, and testing data sets must meet quality criteria including relevance, representativeness, and freedom from errors
requirements.penalty: Up to 15M EUR or 3% global annual turnover

requirements.obligation: Technical documentation must be drawn up before system is placed on market and kept up to date
requirements.penalty: Up to 15M EUR or 3% global annual turnover

requirements.obligation: High-risk AI systems must allow for automatic recording of events (logs) throughout the system lifetime
requirements.penalty: Up to 15M EUR or 3% global annual turnover

requirements.obligation: High-risk AI systems must be designed to enable deployers to interpret system output and use it appropriately
requirements.penalty: Up to 15M EUR or 3% global annual turnover

requirements.obligation: High-risk AI systems must be designed to enable effective human oversight during use
requirements.penalty: Up to 15M EUR or 3% global annual turnover

requirements.obligation: High-risk AI systems must achieve appropriate levels of accuracy, robustness, and cybersecurity
requirements.penalty: Up to 15M EUR or 3% global annual turnover

requirements.obligation: Users must be notified when interacting with an AI system, when content is AI-generated, and when emotion recognition or biometric categorization is used
requirements.penalty: Up to 15M EUR or 3% global annual turnover

requirements.obligation: High-risk AI systems must be registered in the EU database before being placed on market
requirements.penalty: Up to 15M EUR or 3% global annual turnover

requirements.obligation: Providers must report serious incidents to market surveillance authorities
requirements.penalty: Up to 15M EUR or 3% global annual turnover

requirements.obligation: Providers must establish post-market monitoring systems proportionate to the nature and risk of the AI system
requirements.penalty: Up to 15M EUR or 3% global annual turnover

ai_risk_tier: Maps to GAIF Critical for high-risk AI systems (Annex III), GAIF Medium for limited-risk, GAIF Low for minimal-risk

compliance_routing_rules: Route high-risk AI queries through compliant endpoints with Art. 10 data governance
Block prohibited AI use cases (Art. 5) at routing layer
behavioral_contract_thresholds: Safety field must include Art. 15 accuracy, robustness targets
Behav_v increment triggers re-assessment against Art. 9 risk management
disclosure_requirements: Art. 13 interpretability: provide output explanations for high-risk systems
monitoring_requirements: Art. 72 post-market monitoring: continuous behavioral monitoring
Art. 12 logging: automatic event recording throughout lifetime

citation: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 of the European Parliament and of the Council (AI Act)
